en: A black and white image showing a railway station with tracks curving around a platform. The station building, recognizable by its traditional European architecture, stands in the middle distance with a sign visible on it. A man in early 20th-century attire is standing on the platform. There are hills and vegetation in the background, as well as several adjacent buildings. The overall scene has a vintage appearance.
